title: Laplace operators on quantum graphs
summary: We introduce a class of Laplace operators associated with quantum graphs in the operator-system framework. To this end, we investigate structural properties of quantum graphs related to the Schur product and transposition. Our main innovation is the identification of a specific inner product on the space of matrices with respect to which the projection onto the operator system underlying a quantum graph is orthogonal.
